title: The Branch of the LORD

questions.question: And seven women shall take hold of one man in that day, saying, "We will eat our own what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 4:1 (ESV): "We will eat our own bread and wear our own clothes,"

questions.question: Only let us be called by your name; take away our what?
In that day the branch of the LORD shall be beautiful and what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 4:2 (ESV): "the branch of the LORD shall be beautiful and glorious,"

questions.question: And the fruit of the land shall be the pride and honor of the survivors of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 4:2 (ESV): "honor of the survivors of Israel."

questions.question: And he who is left in Zion and remains in Jerusalem will be called what?
When the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 4:4 (ESV): "washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion"

questions.question: And cleansed the bloodstains of Jerusalem from its midst by a spirit of judgment and by a spirit of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 4:4 (ESV): "by a spirit of judgment and by a spirit of burning."

questions.question: Then the LORD will create over the whole site of Mount Zion and over her assemblies a what by day?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 4:5 (ESV): "a cloud by day, and smoke"

questions.question: And smoke and the shining of a flaming what by night?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 4:5 (ESV): "and the shining of a flaming fire by night;"

questions.question: For over all the glory there will be a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 4:5 (ESV): "for over all the glory there will be a canopy."

questions.question: It will be a booth for shade by day from the heat, and for a refuge and a shelter from the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 4:6 (ESV): "refuge and a shelter from the storm and rain."

questions.question: Everyone who has been recorded for what in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 4:3 (ESV): "everyone who has been recorded for life in Jerusalem,"

questions.question: The seven women saying "We will eat our own bread..." implies a shortage of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 4:1 (Context implies shortage of men due to war/judgment mentioned in Chapter 3).

questions.question: In verse 2, the "Branch of the LORD" is generally interpreted by Christians as a reference to whom?
The "cloud by day" and "flaming fire by night" alludes to the imagery of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 4:5 (Allusion to the pillar of cloud and fire during the Exodus).

key_verse_text: In that day the branch of the LORD shall be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land shall be the pride and honor of the survivors of Israel.
